rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken rendering for calling someone by phone, including phoning to say something.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 daa2 din6 waa6 bei2 nei5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken word for a phone as a device, and it can also mean a phone number from context.

example.english: My phone is broken, so let me borrow yours to make a call.
example.traditional: 我部電話壞咗，借部俾我打下。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 din6 waa2 waai6 zo2 ze3 bou6 bei2 ngo5 daa2 haa5

rows.note: Use this when you need to specify a portable or mobile phone rather than a phone in general.

example.english: Don't get so absorbed in your mobile phone on the MTR.
example.traditional: 搭地鐵嗰陣，唔好攞住部手提電話咁出神。
example.jyutping: daap3 dei6 tit3 go2 zan6 m4 hou2 lo2 zyu6 bou6 sau2 tai4 din6 waa2 gam3 ceot1 san4

rows.note: Use this when you mean the digits or contact number specifically rather than the device.

example.english: Could you give me your phone number?
example.traditional: 可唔可以畀個電話號碼我？
example.jyutping: ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 bei2 go3 din6 waa2 hou6 maa5 ngo5
